method: Continue the exact stage-5 BERT-Tiny checkpoint on 50% original and 50% deterministic perturbed copies of training parents. Use a clean fallback when no valid variant exists. This is augmentation training, not online adversarial training.
augmentation_choice: Generate at most twelve candidates using unchanged stage-6 constraints and the split-specific seed. Select the minimum SHA256 rank of choice:variant_id. No model queries. Freeze both partitions before fitting.
preflight: Two training pairs per label/operation, hash-ranked by review:variant_id. Review actual selected training copies before fitting; any ambiguous/invalid decision blocks the run. The sample does not certify every augmentation.
checkpoint_selection: Lowest mean cross-entropy on the concatenated clean and fixed-perturbed validation views, equal weight per parent/view. Earliest epoch wins exact ties. Validation is never fit.
threshold_selection: At the selected checkpoint use clean validation phishing F1 with the existing frozen grid/ties. Report old 0.69 and default 0.50 as diagnostics. No adjustment using benchmark results.
evaluation: Freeze checkpoint/threshold before scoring. Compare baseline v2, stage-5 BERT and defense on the unchanged stage-6 bank and separately seed-43 equal-budget fresh searches. Each bank has at most twelve candidates plus one clean query per original/model. Repeated bank overlap is disclosed, not eliminated by extra queries. Never pool both banks into one nominal 13-query attack.
comparisons: Report clean cost, fixed-first corruption, stage-5 BERT-selected fixed-bank transfer, per-model worst-of-budget candidate ASR, shared eligibility, group intervals and queries. Fresh candidates are selected against each model's own scores. Same finite constraints are not a strongest-attack guarantee.
post_score_review: Two deterministic successful fresh-search variants per cohort/operation for the defended model, ranked by postreview:cohort:operation:variant_id. Record supported/ambiguous/invalid without changing labels, models or protocol.
separation: Original real-mail-v2 groups/splits and stage-5 reviewed-family exclusion remain. Fit opens train/validation only; benchmark scoring opens test/challenge only, plus text-free frozen metadata. Preserve 703 reserve messages unscored/unreviewed.
reproduction: Repeat full preparation, training and evaluation once. Independently recount results and verify all prior model/data digests. No hyperparameter search and no stage 8.
limitations: One fixed seed/configuration. Continued training and augmentation are not separated by a clean-only continued-training control. Known retrospective cohorts, source/era confounding, templates, uncertain labels and partial semantic review remain. Scores are not calibrated probabilities.
